patterns.statement: Barrier collision is global; the per-agent ignore list gives a true per-player unlock without team changes.
patterns.condition: A barrier must open for one player only in multiplayer
patterns.action: Use barrier_device.AddToIgnoreList(Agent) per unlocking player

patterns.statement: A single source of truth for cost on the native device avoids double-charge and desync between Verse and device config.
patterns.condition: An unlock or purchase is gated by a cost
patterns.action: Let the native Conditional Button own both the requirement and consumption; Verse only reacts to ActivatedEvent

patterns.statement: Immediate saves on frequent events are redundant cost; a dirty-gated autosave bounds writes without losing progress.
patterns.condition: A progress value is saved on frequent events like every kill or tick
patterns.action: Set an IsDirty flag and let a periodic autosave loop (about 30s) write it; save immediately only on rare claim, completion or disconnect events

patterns.statement: Plain classes cannot call GetPlayspace; they signal events and the creative_device manager fans out to players, avoiding a god-object.
patterns.condition: A gameplay subsystem is added to a large game manager
patterns.action: Make it a plain class configured via archetype by the manager, signalling state through events the manager subscribes to

patterns.statement: Boss rounds as a bag-draw with re-rolled gap and a capped multi-boss chance gives variety without repeats; the round must end on either win or wipe.
patterns.condition: A wave loop needs periodic boss rounds without repeats
patterns.action: Use a shuffle bag drawn by random index, a random gap re-rolled after each boss event, hard cap on simultaneous bosses, and race all-bosses-defeated against all-players-down

patterns.statement: UEFN caps persistent vars per project (4 in a real BuildAll error); extend an existing persistable class rather than adding a new one.
patterns.condition: A project needs another persistent per-player value but already uses the persistable weak_map slots
patterns.action: Add fields to the existing persistable class and expose get/set accessors instead of declaring a new weak_map

patterns.statement: Spawner fields only affect newly spawned guards; live HP and elimination events come from fort_character.
patterns.condition: A boss needs scaled HP per round
patterns.action: Write Max/Initial Health and Shield on guard_spawner_device before Enable(), read live HP via the spawned agent's fort_character

patterns.statement: A bucket integer from time makes daily reset idempotent across joins and long sessions.
patterns.condition: Daily goals are offered to players
patterns.action: Compute a reset bucket from unix time and reset hour, re-assign random quests excluding previous ones when the bucket changes, and refresh via a sleep until next reset

patterns.statement: Repeated device reads per slot multiply per second per player; one read per slot cuts them.
patterns.condition: A UI refresh loop reads device state for several slots
patterns.action: Compute each live value once per refresh and pass it to the helpers

patterns.statement: Tracker Complete behavior may reset its value to 0, so a live read after completion can regress progress.
patterns.condition: Quest or progress completion depends on a Tracker Device reaching target
patterns.action: Cache the target value into your own persisted state when CompleteEvent fires, and display max(live value, cached value)

patterns.statement: Widgets added without removal accumulate for the whole session on long matches.
patterns.condition: A pop-up widget is added per event to a player's UI
patterns.action: Spawn a cleanup that sleeps the display duration and then RemoveWidget

patterns.statement: Concurrent BuyOffer/ConsumeEntitlement spawns can double-consume an entitlement; the guard is per player so others are not blocked.
patterns.condition: A purchase can be double-clicked in a UI
patterns.action: Keep a per-player in-flight logic map and ignore the request while set

patterns.statement: Keeping the reward in a per-day trigger keeps the device generic; epoch timestamps survive sessions.
patterns.condition: A recurring reward is claimed once per cooldown
patterns.action: Persist ClaimedDays and NextClaimAtEpoch per player, cycle the 7-day window with Mod, let each day fire its own trigger_device wired to the actual reward

patterns.statement: A Verse event Signal with no subscriber is lost, not queued, so listeners must register first (spawn runs up to its first suspension).
patterns.condition: A coroutine awaits an event another coroutine signals at startup
patterns.action: Spawn the awaiters before the signaller

patterns.statement: Versioned persistable data with a copy constructor lets schema grow without wiping players.
patterns.condition: A persistable class needs a new field after release
patterns.action: Version the class, keep a constructor copying old fields, and migrate in GetOrCreate

patterns.statement: Knocked-down players stay connected, so player count cannot distinguish a natural win from a wipe; an explicit flag is needed.
patterns.condition: A round can end by timer, boss defeat or all players down
patterns.action: Race the win condition against a WaitForAllPlayersDown loop and set a RoundEndedEarly flag, gating the round reward on it

patterns.statement: Immediate reset races the in-flight round loop and a fast rejoin; one grace coroutine at a time.
patterns.condition: All players leave
patterns.action: Wait a 5s grace period, re-check the count, and only then reset; guard with a ResetPending flag

patterns.statement: Quantity and variety grow with pools enabled, with no per-round numeric tuning on each device.
patterns.condition: Round difficulty must scale
patterns.action: Add a fixed duration step per round and enable one more tiered spawner pool every 2 rounds, plus random pools rolled independently from a minimum round

patterns.statement: A Stop-completed timer cannot restart without a reset, so the loop hangs silently after round 1.
patterns.condition: A native Timer Device drives round phases and is reused every round
patterns.action: Call Reset() immediately before every Start() when completion behavior is Stop

patterns.statement: External contracts stay unchanged while the manager keeps only the state machine.
patterns.condition: A manager grows into a god object
patterns.action: Extract horde, economy, boss, hive into plain classes built from the manager's own @editable fields in OnBegin, keep external events and triggers on the manager

patterns.statement: One cheap poll keeps the HUD correct regardless of which system granted the item.
patterns.condition: A HUD shows physical item counts
patterns.action: Poll a Conditional Button GetItemCount every 0.5s instead of per-tick or scattered manual refreshes

patterns.statement: Maps keyed by player never pruned leak on long sessions.
patterns.condition: Per-player maps grow with each joining player
patterns.action: Rebuild the map without the departing player's key in OnPlayerRemoved

patterns.statement: A formula instead of a lookup array covers any number of pools.
patterns.condition: Kills must pay scaling gold
patterns.action: Reward = Base + Step*PoolIndex plus a flat per-round bonus, and give random pools a virtual index after the deterministic ones

patterns.statement: Each native spawner class exposes a different cleanup surface; verify in the digest before mirroring another class.
patterns.condition: A spawner device type has no bulk-eliminate call
patterns.action: Use the type's own cleanup API: creature_spawner EliminateCreatures, guard_spawner Despawn(), wildlife_spawner GetAgents plus Despawn(agent), then Disable

patterns.statement: guard_spawner_device has no device-level EliminatedEvent unlike creature_spawner_device.
patterns.condition: Kill rewards are needed for guard NPCs
patterns.action: Subscribe SpawnedEvent, then await that agent's fort_character EliminatedEvent and read EliminatingCharacter.GetAgent[]

patterns.statement: A per-round roll returned to the loop lets UI messaging reflect the actual round type.
patterns.condition: A round can be an invasion variant
patterns.action: Roll an independent invasion chance that activates all hive and invasion spawners together, and return the result so the round-start message can differ

patterns.statement: Persistent data of a departed player is unreadable; message values are not comparable but player values are.
patterns.condition: A leaderboard must show players who already left
patterns.action: Snapshot their stats and name into a capped FIFO in-memory array at leave time, dedup by the player value on rejoin

patterns.statement: Triggers carry no payload, so amounts need a typed event; custom events are awaited in a loop, not subscribed.
patterns.condition: Several modules need lifetime stats
patterns.action: Store them as extra fields on the single existing persistable class and expose get/set accessors; independent listeners subscribe to the same native trigger and to public events carrying amounts

patterns.statement: Supports several boards and fails soft when the prop is missing.
patterns.condition: A world-space widget is shown in the level
patterns.action: Find placed widget entities with GetSimulationEntity[].FindDescendantEntities at OnBegin and write the same rows to each; log a warning when none is placed

patterns.statement: The widget may not be built yet when PlayerAdded fires; avoids a second duplicate widget.
patterns.condition: Another module needs to push a field to the shared HUD widget
patterns.action: Read the widget through the owner's read-only GetWidget accessor and defer the first push with a short Sleep after join

patterns.statement: ui_input_mode.All captures movement and voice keys; custom events are awaited, not subscribed.
patterns.condition: A widget is a passive HUD that must not block movement or push-to-talk
patterns.action: Add it with ui_input_mode.None and watch its CloseEvent via Await in a spawned task

patterns.statement: Session-scoped one-shot guards stop join/leave exploits; basis-point integer math avoids missing int-float conversion.
patterns.condition: Co-op retention needs a reason to play in a group
patterns.action: Detect party size via Player.GetLocalParty, grant a once-per-session bonus scaled by party size with integer basis points, show a solo nudge after the first completed round

patterns.statement: A creative_device cannot reach the behavior instance; a disconnecting player never fires AgentExitsEvent.
patterns.condition: An NPC persona conversation is per player
patterns.action: Put conversation target and voice channel setup in a custom npc_behavior, locate the device by tag lookup, and tear down on both volume exit and PlayerRemovedEvent

patterns.statement: A repeating ruler over a never-reset counter rewards retention; coroutines are not auto-cancelled on leave.
patterns.condition: Playtime rewards should keep paying for a long session
patterns.action: Track one continuous per-player elapsed counter in a spawned coroutine and repeat the ordered checkpoint list cyclically on top of it, stopping the coroutine via an ActivePlayers map on disconnect

patterns.statement: StopSay and PromptFailure events cannot be scoped to one player in multiplayer.
patterns.condition: Persona events carry no player identity
patterns.action: Treat reset-all-active-widgets as a documented limitation and set a safe unavailable state on prompt failure

patterns.statement: A stale or out-of-order call can never lower a recorded max.
patterns.condition: A maximum value like best round is stored
patterns.action: Write only when the new value is strictly higher

patterns.statement: A gentle exponential (about 1.1x) keeps early levels quick and long sessions meaningful; multi-level jumps must fire per level.
patterns.condition: Prestige levels are uncapped
patterns.action: Use Threshold(L) = Base * Multiplier^(L-1) via an iterative loop, carry excess points over, fire a LevelUp trigger once per level gained

patterns.statement: Tracker persistence and Complete behavior are undocumented traps; the weak_map has documented semantics.
patterns.condition: Persistence must survive a disconnect
patterns.action: Use Epic's persistable class in a module weak_map, auto-loaded on join, instead of Tracker Devices

patterns.statement: A bidirectional using between Verse modules is a package cycle that halts compilation project-wide.
patterns.condition: Two modules would depend on each other through typed device references
patterns.action: Make one direction a signal over shared native trigger_devices and push the outcome through a one-way reference

patterns.statement: A class literal that omits a field resets it to default, silently zeroing other stats.
patterns.condition: A persistable class is written by several setters
patterns.action: Read a snapshot and rebuild the full object carrying every field forward, checking FitsInPlayerMap before set

patterns.statement: Round signals via shared native triggers keep effects decoupled from the manager; Enable alone may not restart a spawner that starts disabled.
patterns.condition: An ambient effect should appear in some rounds
patterns.action: Listen independently to round-start and round-end triggers, roll an activation percentage, enable one random VFX spawner with Enable then Restart, disable it at round end

patterns.statement: Marketplace policy requires paid advantages to be obtainable without payment; one shared grant trigger keeps a single entry point.
patterns.condition: A V-Bucks product could give a gameplay advantage
patterns.action: Also offer a non-monetary path (for example VIP at a prestige level) via a shared trigger that every grant source fires

patterns.statement: One entitlement type and one purchase surface avoids two ownership sources.
patterns.condition: A product could be bought from several surfaces
patterns.action: Expose the entitlement module as public and have the shop reference the same entitlement type as the owning manager

patterns.statement: Verse maps have no key removal; one reusable helper avoids copy-pasted rebuild loops.
patterns.condition: A per-player map needs a key removed
patterns.action: Use a generic WithRemovedKey helper that rebuilds the map via ConcatenateMaps

patterns.statement: A single enable and disable schedule on pre-placed pools gives quantity and variety growth with no per-round device tuning.
patterns.condition: Building a wave survival map from scratch
patterns.action: Place 3 phase timers plus tiered spawner pools disabled at start, then a manager that enables pool N from round 1+2N and disables all at round end

patterns.statement: A shared trigger bus keeps leaderboard, VFX, party and prestige modules independent of the manager.
patterns.condition: Several systems need the same gameplay signal
patterns.action: Fire one shared trigger_device per signal (kill, round start, round complete, diamond earned) and bind it into every listener's own editable slot

patterns.statement: The island time limit and round count are unused when the Verse manager owns the loop.
patterns.condition: Setting up the island for a co-op wave map
patterns.action: Set max players 4, Squads, one island round, and drive the loop from Verse

patterns.statement: The 4 persistent var cap, unbounded per-player maps and empty pool arrays are recurring late failures.
patterns.condition: Before publishing a map with an infinite loop and persistence
patterns.action: Verify persistent var count is at most 4, per-player maps are pruned on leave, and all pool arrays are populated

patterns.statement: A 0.5s poll over all players otherwise allocates a message and writes MVVM every tick for values that rarely change.
patterns.condition: A HUD value is refreshed by a periodic poll for every player
patterns.action: Cache the last value written per player and skip the widget write and log line when unchanged; reset the cache when the widget is rebuilt and prune it on leave

patterns.statement: Disable() is device-wide; refunding the duplicate charge keeps the button usable for other players without a double spend.
patterns.condition: A native device has no per-player disable and a player can re-trigger a paid action already owned
patterns.action: Detect the already-owned state in the activation handler and refund the cost read dynamically from the device (GetItemCountRequired) through an item granter

patterns.statement: GrantItem returns void; the event with an agent-match guard is the only way to detect a silently failed grant on a shared granter.
patterns.condition: An item granter GrantItem call has no return value but a refund or grant must be confirmed
patterns.action: Spawn a race between a loop awaiting ItemGrantedEvent matched to the agent and a 2s timeout that logs a CRITICAL line

patterns.statement: Verse exposes no public task Cancel; race plus a signalled event is the structured way to avoid orphaned suspended tasks across rounds.
patterns.condition: Per-entity coroutines (for example one per boss) must be cancelled when a round ends and task Cancel() is not public
patterns.action: Wrap each task body in a race against a shared event signalled at round end, so the losing branch and everything nested in it is cancelled

patterns.statement: Without a cap each earn adds a widget and a sleeping task for the display duration; the cap bounds UI and task cost and the reward is unaffected.
patterns.condition: Kills or rewards can fire pop-up widgets many times in quick succession
patterns.action: Keep a per-player counter in a weak_map, skip the cosmetic pop-up over a cap (default 8) and release the slot in the spawned cleanup after the display duration

patterns.statement: Without a cap, rapid kills stack one widget and one cleanup task each for the full display time; a per-player cap bounds both and is purely cosmetic.
patterns.condition: Frequent cosmetic UI pop-ups are spawned per reward event
patterns.action: Cap simultaneously visible pop-ups per player with a weak_map counter and release the slot in the cleanup task

patterns.statement: Verse has no public task Cancel; racing against a cancel event cuts off all nested suspended work and prevents orphan tasks.
patterns.condition: A spawned per-entity tracking task must be cancelled when the round ends
patterns.action: Wrap the task body in a race against an event that the round-end routine signals

patterns.statement: A stored integer bucket makes resets idempotent across sessions and rejoins, with no per-player timers.
patterns.condition: Daily or periodic quests must reset for all players at a fixed time of day
patterns.action: Compute a reset bucket as floor((unixTime - resetHour*3600)/86400), compare it with the player's stored bucket, and run one loop that sleeps until the next boundary

patterns.statement: Repeated device getters inside refresh helpers multiply reads per second per player; compute once and share.
patterns.condition: A live widget refreshes every second and reads device state per slot
patterns.action: Read each device value once per slot per refresh and pass it to the helpers that format progress, text and button state

patterns.statement: Never trust a live tracker read after completion; a cached completion value stops progress regressing.
patterns.condition: A tracker device may reset its own value when its target is reached
patterns.action: Cache the target value into the persisted progress in the completion handler and display the max of live and cached value

patterns.statement: A persisted next-claim timestamp keeps the cooldown honest across sessions; the cycle index comes from a modulo and the reward stays configurable on native triggers.
patterns.condition: A per-player login or daily reward with a cooldown
patterns.action: Persist ClaimedDays and NextClaimAtEpoch per player, let only the day equal to ClaimedDays mod N be claimable once now >= NextClaimAtEpoch, and fire a per-day trigger for the actual reward

patterns.statement: An event signalled before anyone awaits is lost, not queued; ordering the spawns removes the race.
patterns.condition: A timed event must signal listeners that start waiting at the same moment
patterns.action: Spawn the Await watchers before the coroutine that signals, and use a single device-level loop for the widget phases

patterns.statement: A grace window with a pending flag stops rapid leave/rejoin from racing several resets, and a boss round also needs a timeout race so a failed spawn cannot softlock the loop.
patterns.condition: All players are down or leave during a round
patterns.action: End the round early without paying the round reward, wait a 5s grace period after the last player leaves with a single-flight flag, then reset only if still empty

patterns.statement: A reset timer never fires success and a completed Stop-mode timer cannot restart, so without the race and the Reset the loop hangs or silently skips rounds.
patterns.condition: A wave loop waits on a native timer that a reset can stop
patterns.action: Race the timer SuccessEvent against a ResetSignal event that the reset routine fires, and Reset() a stopped timer before each Start()

patterns.statement: Tiered pools plus a linear payout scale quantity, variety and reward with no per-round tuning tables.
patterns.condition: Rounds scale difficulty by round number
patterns.action: Enable one more spawner pool every 2 rounds, add independent random pools from a minimum round with a fixed chance, and pay kill gold as base plus step times pool index plus a per-round bonus

patterns.statement: Spawner devices do not share a bulk-despawn API, so cleanup must match the type; check the digest before assuming a call exists.
patterns.condition: A wave spawner pool must be cleaned up at round end and the spawner type differs
patterns.action: Use the cleanup call each device type really has: EliminateCreatures for creature spawners, DespawnAll(false) for NPC spawners, per-agent GetAgents then Despawn for wildlife spawners, then Disable

patterns.statement: A single independent roll with a returned flag gives surprise rounds that the UI can announce without extra state.
patterns.condition: A special rare round (invasion) should occasionally replace a normal wave
patterns.action: Roll once per round from a minimum round and, on a hit, enable every spawner of both pools and return a flag so the loop shows a distinct round-start message

patterns.statement: Item grants and Print carry no_rollback effects that cannot live inside a decides function.
patterns.condition: A Verse function must grant items and also be able to fail
patterns.action: Split it: a decides function that only updates the balance map, and a separate always-succeeding function that grants items and logs, called only after the first succeeds

patterns.statement: An agent-name message renders empty after the player leaves, and a stale snapshot shows the same player twice after a rejoin.
patterns.condition: A leaderboard or HUD shows departed players or has to survive a rejoin
patterns.action: Store a frozen snapshot keyed by player identity, dedupe it on rejoin and before each new snapshot, cap the list FIFO, and store a generic label instead of a lazily rendered agent-name message

patterns.statement: Batched writes bound persistent-write cost; flushing before a snapshot or leave keeps the displayed value correct.
patterns.condition: Per-player lifetime stats are updated on every kill or reward event
patterns.action: Accumulate deltas in an in-memory pending counter and flush them in one batched write per player on a periodic loop and before a player leaves

patterns.statement: A single failed GetPlayerUI at join leaves the player without a widget for the whole session; the run counter stops older animations cutting newer ones.
patterns.condition: A UI widget creation can run before the player UI is ready
patterns.action: Retry creation in a loop every 0.25-0.5s up to about 10s, stop if the player left, and guard overlapping animations with a per-player run counter

patterns.statement: Input mode All captures every input including movement; None makes the widget non-clickable, so a clickable on-screen button needs a separate design.
patterns.condition: A passive HUD or status widget must not block movement or push-to-talk
patterns.action: Add it with ui_input_mode None and reserve All for deliberate modal popups that also pause the player with a camera

patterns.statement: Decides effects are rejected inside Subscribe callback chains, and uncancelled per-player subscriptions keep firing for departed players.
patterns.condition: A callback chain driven by Subscribe must do arithmetic or per-player work
patterns.action: Avoid decides calls such as Quotient or a bare slash in that call graph, hand-roll the division, store each player's cancelables and prune every per-player map on leave

patterns.statement: A once-per-session bonus never reset on party changes cannot be exploited by leaving and rejoining; confirming the grant exposes silent inventory-cap failures.
patterns.condition: A co-op map should reward playing in a party
patterns.action: Scale a one-time-per-session bonus by party size in integer basis points, grant it through a dedicated item granter, and confirm the grant with the granter event raced against a short timeout

patterns.statement: Replacing or pruning a token cancels a pending timeout without a task handle, so stale timers cannot reset newer state.
patterns.condition: A task or timer cannot be cancelled and a state may change while it sleeps
patterns.action: Give each armed timer a per-player token, store it in a map, and on wake-up do nothing if the stored token no longer matches

patterns.statement: A disconnect inside the activation area never fires the exit event, and events without player identity must reset all active widgets to a safe state.
patterns.condition: An AI conversation widget can be left stuck in listening or thinking
patterns.action: Arm a timeout when the player finishes speaking, reset the widget to an unavailable state on error or timeout, and tear down the pairing both on volume exit and on player removal

patterns.statement: An island has a small hard cap on persistent variables, and a class literal that omits a field resets it to the default, so a single copy helper prevents silent data loss.
patterns.condition: More persistent state is needed than the platform allows module-scoped persistent variables
patterns.action: Keep one persistable class in one weak_map, add new fields with defaults, and write only through a single copy helper that carries every field forward and checks the size guard

patterns.statement: A roll range starting at zero gives an extra outcome so a zero percent chance still fires; a device that starts disabled may need Restart after Enable to spawn.
patterns.condition: A random ambient effect should appear on some rounds only
patterns.action: Roll an integer from 1 to the upper bound against a percent, pick one effect device at random, Enable then Restart it, and disable it at round end

patterns.statement: Barrier collision is global, so a per-player ignore list is the unlock; the ignore state must be re-applied after respawn and the bonus guarded against repeat grants.
patterns.condition: A VIP or unlocked area is gated by a barrier for non-qualifying players
patterns.action: Add qualifying players to each barrier ignore list, re-apply after respawn, and guard the one-time bonus with an in-memory per-session map

patterns.statement: Per-player persisted redemption stops reuse across sessions, and a text version counter prevents an older timed reset from wiping a newer message.
patterns.condition: A code-entry device lets players redeem codes for rewards
patterns.action: Persist redeemed codes per player for one-time codes, version every message shown with a counter so a stale delayed reset cannot clear newer text, and fire a configurable trigger on success

patterns.statement: A per-iteration counter drifts slow under load, and the last checkpoint of a cycle is never crossed unless the wrap is counted.
patterns.condition: A timed reward ladder repeats over one continuous play counter
patterns.action: Measure elapsed time against the real clock and count the cycle wrap as the last checkpoint

patterns.statement: A bare logic literal is not decidable: the false branch still succeeds, so a leap-year check said every year was leap and dates drifted by days. Use the query operator or a comparison.
patterns.condition: A decides function ends its branches in bare true/false logic literals
patterns.action: End failing branches with the query operator or a real comparison

patterns.statement: Racing boss-defeat against wipe alone softlocks the loop when the pool is empty or a spawn fails; a third timeout branch frees the loop without a separate reward path.
patterns.condition: A round loop waits on a boss defeat that may never come
patterns.action: Add a maximum-duration branch to the race that counts as a soft win

patterns.statement: Reusing the kill trigger for a bonus reward inflates persistent kill counts and kill accolades; a read-only in-progress flag or a dedicated trigger keeps counters honest.
patterns.condition: A special reward such as a boss kill reuses the normal kill trigger
patterns.action: Raise a reward-in-progress flag or use a separate trigger so kill counters ignore it

patterns.statement: A file-level editable compiles but never appears in the Details panel of the placed device, so the switch cannot be toggled; declare it as a class member.
patterns.condition: A configurable switch is declared at file level
patterns.action: Declare editable switches as members of the placed device class

patterns.statement: Picking the highest threshold not above the level avoids per-level iteration and flicker; skipping the fire when the tier is unchanged also handles multi-level jumps and rejoin.
patterns.condition: A level-based cosmetic tier must follow the level in both directions
patterns.action: Compute the target tier directly from the level and only fire a change when it differs from the old one

patterns.statement: Firing on the crossing, not on level at or above the threshold at every award, makes the unlock happen once without a separate persisted guard field.
patterns.condition: A one-time bonus is unlocked by crossing a level threshold
patterns.action: Compare the level before and after the change and fire only on the crossing edge

patterns.statement: Scaling fields only affect newly spawned NPCs; a spawner type without those fields still compiles but the scaling silently does nothing.
patterns.condition: Boss HP or shield must scale per round on a spawned NPC
patterns.action: Use a spawner type that exposes Max/Initial Health and Shield fields, write them before Enable(), and read live HP from the spawned agent's fort_character

patterns.statement: A device that resets its counter on completion can read back 0 right after; recording the completion yourself keeps progress from regressing.
patterns.condition: A quest or goal completes through a device event whose own counter may reset at completion
patterns.action: Cache the target value into your own saved progress when the completion event fires, and display the max of live value and cached value

patterns.statement: Diffing by signature cuts UI field writes and device reads per player per second without changing what the player sees.
patterns.condition: A UI refresh loop rewrites many widget fields every second
patterns.action: Keep a per-slot signature (item, value, claimed) on the widget session and write a slot's fields only when its signature changed; static fields once

patterns.statement: A bare true/false literal in a decides function always succeeds, so every year counted as leap and countdowns drifted by whole days.
patterns.condition: A real-world date (event start/end) is converted to unix time in Verse
patterns.action: Write the leap-year check with query results (true? / false?) and comparisons, never bare logic literals, and verify one known date against a hand-computed value

patterns.statement: Subscribe cannot tell sources apart when one function is bound to many devices; a relay with a fixed index fixes tier-based rewards.
patterns.condition: One shared kill handler must know which spawner pool fired
patterns.action: Bind a small relay object per pool carrying the pool index to each spawner event instead of one shared callback

patterns.statement: A bare event can lose same-tick signals; a drained queue per consumer cannot, and a cap stops an absent consumer growing it forever.
patterns.condition: Two awards can fire in the same tick and listeners re-Await only after handling
patterns.action: Append each award to a per-consumer capped queue and use the event Signal only as a wake-up; consumers drain the queue

patterns.statement: Reused triggers inflate lifetime kill stats; and a boss round with no spawn would otherwise softlock the loop unless a timeout branch ends it as a soft win.
patterns.condition: A boss reward reuses the same trigger as normal kills
patterns.action: Raise an in-progress flag during the reward fan-out so stats listeners skip it, or offer a separate trigger; also add a max-duration timeout as a third race branch of the boss round

patterns.statement: Throttling fan-out writes keeps the last value always shown while cutting widget writes from per-hit to per-interval.
patterns.condition: Many players change a shared value (boss HP) many times a second and every change writes widgets for all players
patterns.action: Store only the newest payload plus a dirty flag, and let a pusher loop write widgets at most N times per second

patterns.statement: The physical item is the single source of truth, so an extra Verse-side balance map is dead weight.
patterns.condition: Rewards must be exact and survive reconnects
patterns.action: Keep no Verse balance; grant the real currency as a physical item through an item granter whose count is set just before each grant

patterns.statement: Retrying until the player UI is ready and racing against leave avoids a missing HUD on late joins without leaking tasks.
patterns.condition: A per-player HUD widget must be attached to every current and future player
patterns.action: Spawn one task per player that races a player-removed wait against a loop retrying until the player UI exists, then adds the widget

patterns.statement: Batching deltas bounds persistent writes while keeping the displayed value (persistent plus pending) correct.
patterns.condition: Frequent events (kills, gold, diamonds) update lifetime persistent stats
patterns.action: Accumulate per-player pending deltas in memory and flush them in one batched write on a periodic loop and when the player leaves

patterns.statement: Plain event() signals can merge or be missed when fired in the same tick; a queue drained on wake-up or timeout never loses an award.
patterns.condition: A manager must notify other devices of awards but custom event() values cannot be Subscribed
patterns.action: Use the event only as a wake-up raced against a short Sleep, and have the consumer drain a queue holding every award

patterns.statement: A name built from an agent renders empty after the player leaves, so frozen snapshots keyed by player identity avoid blank and duplicate rows.
patterns.condition: A leaderboard must list live and departed players in a long session
patterns.action: Keep a capped array of snapshots of departed players, remove the old snapshot on rejoin, and store a generic name label for them

patterns.statement: A relay object carries per-player context into shared events and lets you unsubscribe cleanly when the player leaves.
patterns.condition: A shared listenable must call back with per-player context and local functions or lambdas are unsupported
patterns.action: Create a small per-player relay class holding the player and manager, subscribe its method, keep the cancelables per player and cancel them on leave

patterns.statement: Granting returns no result, so confirming through the event catches silent failures such as inventory caps.
patterns.condition: An item is granted through a device whose grant call returns nothing
patterns.action: Race the device's granted event against a short timeout and log a critical line when it never fires
